purpose: Synthetic logical reference data and expected outcomes for #462. Not a production seed, migration, import file, or executable proof of permissions.
date_semantics: Starts inclusive; ends exclusive. Business-date semantics remain a prototype default.
instructions: Read design.md and tasks.md first; reconcile with current main and linked issues before implementing.
FK values below are IDs. Display ID — Name to people.
Each verification case starts fresh unless it explicitly references a prior case.
Map logical records to approved Table metadata; create test data inline in existing Postgres rollback sandbox tests, not by loading this file as a test fixture.
Trusted bootstrap is separate from ordinary authorised grant/save operations.
V22–V24, V28 and the initial R1 field set are owner-approved. Remaining physical schema and resolver/date contract choices are documented in design.md.

verification_cases.name: No delegated access yet
verification_cases.action: Arun reads or changes Priya
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; Arun retains own-record self service.

verification_cases.name: Bounded grant
verification_cases.action: Meera grants RA6 as shown in examples
verification_cases.expected: Allow; Arun receives R1 only within SC2. Record grantor and continuing authority.

verification_cases.name: Delegated edit is held
verification_cases.action: Arun updates E3.phone to demo-phone-priya-new
verification_cases.expected: Create pending CP1 and proposal change; E3.phone stays demo-phone-priya-old.

verification_cases.name: Approve current proposal
verification_cases.action: Meera approves CP1
verification_cases.expected: Apply E3.phone; CP1 applied; decision/history identify maker Arun and approver Meera.

verification_cases.name: No self approval
verification_cases.action: Arun approves CP1
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; proposal pending and live phone unchanged.

verification_cases.name: Read does not imply write
verification_cases.action: Arun changes E3.employee_number, alone or alongside phone
verification_cases.expected: Refuse entire row change; no partial phone change or accepted forbidden column.

verification_cases.name: Other department
verification_cases.action: Arun reads/updates E4 Ravi in Clothing
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; no broader employee data disclosure.

verification_cases.name: Other store
verification_cases.action: Arun reads/updates E5 Leela in Store B
verification_cases.expected: Refuse.

verification_cases.name: Own phone
verification_cases.action: Arun edits E2.phone
verification_cases.expected: Apply under separate RA5/AR3, not delegated authority.

verification_cases.name: Missing scope
verification_cases.setup: base + an attempted R1 assignment without a Scope
verification_cases.action: Arun reads or updates another employee
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; missing scope never means unrestricted.

verification_cases.name: Revoked maker
verification_cases.action: Meera approves CP1
verification_cases.expected: Refuse application; live record unchanged.

verification_cases.name: Transfer
verification_cases.setup: base + RA6; end JA3 at 2026-11-01 and start JA6 (examples)
verification_cases.action: Compare Arun access to E3 on 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-01
verification_cases.expected: Before: access through Homeware; on transfer: no delegated access. Any pending proposal rechecks membership.

verification_cases.name: Department is not direct reports
verification_cases.action: Arun accesses Priya; repeat with RA6.scope=SC4
verification_cases.expected: SC2 allows department membership; SC4 does not match Priya without reporting link.

verification_cases.name: Successor continuity
verification_cases.setup: V03; end JA1 at 2026-11-01 and start trusted JA7 (examples)
verification_cases.action: On 2026-11-01 Meera and Ravi separately try approval
verification_cases.expected: Meera refused; Ravi may approve as current AU1 holder. RA6 issuer stays Meera and scope stays bounded.

verification_cases.name: Acting appointment escalation
verification_cases.action: Meera attempts JA8 (examples), conferring Store Manager roles on Ravi
verification_cases.expected: Refuse atomically: DB1 cannot confer R2/R3/R4 indirectly through a job row.

verification_cases.name: Direct grant escalation
verification_cases.action: Meera tries granting R3 rather than R1 under DB1, or allowing further delegation
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; maintenance and Access Admin are different capabilities.

verification_cases.name: Conflict
verification_cases.setup: V03; Meera changes live E3.phone to demo-phone-priya-current
verification_cases.action: Meera attempts old approval
verification_cases.expected: No overwrite; show original/current/proposed and require a fresh decision.

verification_cases.name: No Employee create/delete
verification_cases.action: Arun creates or deletes an Employee
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; read/update permissions do not grant either operation.

verification_cases.name: Column-specific narrower grant
verification_cases.setup: Replace RA6.role with narrower R7 defined in examples
verification_cases.action: Arun edits E3.phone and E3.emergency_contact separately
verification_cases.expected: Phone may be proposed; emergency contact remains readable but cannot be changed.

verification_cases.name: Reject proposal
verification_cases.action: Meera rejects CP1 with a reason
verification_cases.expected: Live data unchanged; decision and reason recorded.

verification_cases.name: Mandatory approval overrides immediate
verification_cases.setup: base + explicit mandatory phone approval rule for everyone
verification_cases.action: Arun edits own phone and tries self approval
verification_cases.expected: Held despite AR3; self approval refused; authorised other approver required.

verification_cases.name: Shared contact through one authorised membership
verification_cases.setup: Priya has current Store A and Store B assignments; Meera has R1/R2 within Store A only.
verification_cases.action: Meera updates E3.phone through her Store A contact-maintenance grant.
verification_cases.expected: Allow under the applicable approval rule. The single shared contact value changes for both stores. Other column restrictions remain; this grants no authority to change Store B job assignments.

verification_cases.name: Mixed-scope bulk request
verification_cases.setup: Base + RA6. Priya (E3) is permitted; Ravi (E4, Clothing) is outside Arun’s department scope.
verification_cases.action: Arun submits one bulk request to correct E3.phone and E4.phone.
verification_cases.expected: Accept the E3 correction as pending approval under AR2; reject E4 with a row-specific reason. Both live phone values remain unchanged at submission: E3 waits for approval and E4 is forbidden. Return distinct per-row outcomes; do not claim both applied or reject the permitted correction solely because E4 failed.

verification_cases.name: Approver-only authority
verification_cases.setup: Base + RA6 and pending CP1. In this isolated variant remove JC1/derived RA1 so Meera holds scoped R2 approval authority but no R1 direct-edit permission. Her approval authority covers E3 and C4.
verification_cases.action: Meera approves CP1; separately attempt an ordinary direct contact edit as Meera.
verification_cases.expected: Apply the reviewed CP1 after rechecking Arun’s current edit authority and Meera’s approval scope/columns; record both identities and run normal validation/save hooks. Refuse the separate direct edit. Approval grants no general editing power or self-approval.

verification_cases.name: Complete grants cannot cross-multiply
verification_cases.setup: One narrow grant permits phone; another broader grant permits emergency contact
verification_cases.action: Attempt phone update only covered by the broader grant’s rows
verification_cases.expected: Refuse unless one complete grant covers both target and phone.

verification_cases.name: Correlated scope tuples
verification_cases.setup: Add D4 — Clothing in S2. Scope tuples permit (S1,D1) OR (S2,D4). Existing D2 is Clothing in S1; D3 is Homeware in S2.
verification_cases.action: Try records in (S1,D2) and (S2,D3), which are valid organisation combinations but unlisted in the grant
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; never produce the cross-product of allowed stores and departments.

verification_cases.name: Platform protection separate
verification_cases.action: Arun directly edits platform access holdings or system-written audit history
verification_cases.expected: Refuse; removing app decides_scope does not unlock either platform access or system-written tables.

verification_cases.name: Operational contacts do not change account access
verification_cases.setup: Base. Separately create a synthetic sign-in/recovery phone for Priya using the existing account model; its initial value may equal E3.phone. Account identifiers are not Employee contact columns.
verification_cases.action: Meera corrects E3.phone through her authorised employee contact operation.
verification_cases.expected: Only the operational Employee phone changes under applicable approval rules. Sign-in/recovery identifiers and verification state remain unchanged; Meera gains no account-management permission. Account changes require their separate verified flow.

agreed_sample_field_set.note: Baseline example for RA6, not a universal restriction. Changes follow approval rules; other roles may select different columns.
